faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ADA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ADA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Consultant (Technical), 1 Consultant (Non-Technical).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ADA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 23 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 63 years for all categories of retired employees (as on closing date of application).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Fixed monthly consolidated remuneration based on the last Pay drawn in the Pay level /Pay Scale at the time of retirement for Consultant (Technical), Fixed monthly consolidated remuneration based on the last Pay drawn in the Pay level /Pay Scale at the time of retirement for Consultant (Non-Technical).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Officers/officials retired from Central Government and its autonomous bodies, PSUs or Govt. R&D organisations, with practical knowledge and experience in the field applied for (as per TOR); effective oral and written communication and interpersonal skills. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Effective communication (oral and written) and interpersonal skills with a strong flair for in-depth examination of own areas of work.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retired government servant without a gap of fifteen (15) days between retirement and appointment as consultant.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview at ADA, Bangalore. Candidates meeting the qualification and eligibility criteria attend interview at ADA, Bangalore. Interview date and time intimated to shortlisted candidates by mail. Reporting time 09:00 AM at ADA, Vibhuthipura, Marathahalli Post, Bangalore - 560 037.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No annual increment or percentage increase during the period of Consultancy. Fixed monthly conveyance allowance remains unchanged for the term of Consultancy. No DA, transport facility, residential accommodation, personal staff, CHSS or medical reimbursement.
